user.title: Pair with your DARB hub

data.url: Hub address (the one the app shows with the code)

pair.title: Pair with the DARB hub at {url}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair with DARB
reauth_confirm.description:
The hub at {url} no longer accepts Home Assistant's key: it was revoked, replaced by a newer connection, or the hub was reset. In the Darb app (as an admin): Settings › Devices › Connect Home Assistant › Make Home Assistant code. It looks like ABCDE-FGH23. Enter the new code.

{detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub. If the address is https, the hub's certificate must be one Home Assistant trusts (e.g. Let's Encrypt); otherwise use the http address.
error.no_key: That is not a Home Assistant code. It looks like ABCDE-FGH23: Darb app › Settings › Devices › Connect Home Assistant.
error.no_url: Enter the hub address too: the Darb app shows it with the code.
error.code_used: That code has been used or has expired (codes last 15 minutes, one use). Make a new one in the Darb app.
error.phone_link: That is a pairing link for a phone or browser. For Home Assistant use Settings › Devices › Connect Home Assistant in the Darb app: it shows a short code like ABCDE-FGH23.

abort.already_configured: This DARB hub is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: A DARB hub is already set up.

create_task.name: Propose a task
create_task.description: Proposes a task to DARB's Bot Herder, which checks it against each body's safety envelope before anything moves, and may delay or refuse it.

goal.name: Goal
goal.description: What should be done, in plain words.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: fetch, observe, say, show or plan.

required_capabilities.name: Required capabilities
required_capabilities.description: Only bodies with all of these are considered, e.g. see, grasp.

answer_approval.name: Answer an approval
answer_approval.description: Approves or denies a request waiting on a person. The request id is in the Approvals waiting sensor's attributes.

init.title: Expose to DARB
init.description:
The devices DARB may know about. DARB uses them in conversations, for planning (who is home, doors, temperatures), and in tasks the Bot Herder runs. This list is DARB's own: it does not change what Home Assistant's other assistants see.

Locks, alarm panels, garage doors and gates can be controlled only with a person's approval in the Darb app, never by voice alone.

data_description.see: Sensors, people, doors, weather: DARB reads them but never changes them.
data_description.control: Lights, switches, covers, climate...: DARB may also turn them on, off, open or set.
